interpretation_boundary: This ledger tests QM-readiness of a reduced classical link model. v0.3.5 adds fail-fast spectral preflight, analytic-Fourier/spectral derivative guards, fixed physical self-exclusion arcs and D-dimensionalized energy terms. A separate N- and spectral-cutoff audit is still required before closure comparisons. It does not derive Born probabilities, Hilbert space, hbar, operator commutators, or empirical particle spectra.
